name: Real estate (rules from jRE)
note: An optional rule pack for the benchmark (CONS-0068). It is written from jRE's documented data-quality rules, as rules and thresholds, not code. The default report loads no pack and knows nothing about a file's topic; nothing here runs unless this file is loaded with ?pack=real-estate or the file picker.

checks.title: the same {field} appears four or more times
checks.wording: {count} records report the same {field} ({value}). Check for duplicate entries and compare their source details.
checks.reason: {count} records report the same {field} ({value}). Check for duplicate entries and compare their source details.
checks.rule: Four or more records with exactly the same sale price in one batch are suspicious (jRE rule TXN.REPEAT_PRICE_BATCH, severity critical, confidence 0.75 plus 0.05 per extra record).
checks.source: jRE backend/app/services/data_quality_service.py repeated_value_issue (lines 56-77); docs/reference/DATA_SOURCES.md validation contract, repeated-value case

checks.title: {field} far from its three closest comparables
checks.wording: {field} may be too {dir}: the {k} closest comparables by {by} average {avg}. This is advisory and does not reject the record.
checks.rule: A price more than two (population) standard deviations from the average of the three closest comparable records (nearest living area in the same city) is flagged as a warning; outliers stay advisory (jRE rule TXN.PRICE_CONTEXT).
checks.source: jRE backend/app/services/data_quality_service.py price_context_issue (lines 80-121); docs/reference/DATA_MODEL.md lines 704 and 718 (validity is hard, outliers are advisory)

checks.title: {field} more than two away from its closest comparables
checks.wording: {field} may be too {dir} compared with the closest comparable records (average {avg}).
checks.rule: Bedrooms use an absolute two-unit tolerance against the average of the three closest comparables, because a fractional room matters more than a standard deviation on a small sample (jRE rule NUMERIC.CONTEXT).

checks.title: {field} more than two away from its closest comparables
checks.wording: {field} may be too {dir} compared with the closest comparable records (average {avg}).
checks.rule: Bathrooms use the same absolute two-unit tolerance as bedrooms (jRE rule NUMERIC.CONTEXT).

checks.title: a required field is blank
checks.wording: Required field '{field}' is missing or blank.
checks.rule: A transaction needs a location, a transaction date and a price; blank or missing is a warning (jRE rule GEN.REQUIRED_FIELD, required fields lot_id, transaction_date, price).

checks.title: {field} is not a number
checks.wording: {field} cannot be parsed as a number.
checks.rule: A sale price that cannot be parsed as a finite number is a hard validity failure (jRE rule TXN.PRICE_NUMERIC, severity critical).
